strings.en: Wound care — preventing secondary bacterial infection

strings.zh: 傷口完全癒合後的疤痕處理
strings.en: Scar management after wounds fully heal

strings.zh: 臺灣皮膚科醫學會官方資源
從出疹到完全癒合，猴痘皮膚病灶會依序經歷下列階段：
strings.en: From rash onset to full healing, mpox skin lesions progress through these stages:

strings.zh: TDA 官方建議的處置原則：
有任何感染徵象、症狀加劇、無法忍受的疼痛或精神症狀，請立即至感染科或急診就醫。
strings.en: If you notice any signs of infection, worsening symptoms, intolerable pain, or neurological/psychiatric symptoms, seek immediate care at infectious disease clinic or ER.
hands, feet, chest, face, inside the mouth

strings.zh: 生殖器附近（陰莖、睪丸、陰唇、陰道）
strings.en: near the genitals (penis, testicles, labia, vagina)

strings.zh: 不可使用清潔用酒精擦拭病灶 — 會加劇刺激
strings.en: Do NOT wipe lesions with cleaning alcohol — it worsens irritation

strings.zh: 濕敷：乾淨毛巾或紗布以冷水沖洗後擰乾，放在不適部位幾分鐘
strings.en: Wet compress: rinse a clean towel or gauze in cold water, wring it out, and place on uncomfortable areas for a few minutes

strings.zh: 不共用毛巾、浴巾、剃刀、衣物或其他直接接觸皮膚的衛生用品
strings.en: Do not share towels, bath towels, razors, clothing, or other items in direct skin contact

strings.zh: 髒汙衣物與床單應分開洗滌（熱水 + 漂白水）
strings.en: Wash soiled clothes and bedding separately (hot water + bleach)

strings.zh: 避免性接觸與皮膚密切接觸，直到所有病灶結痂脫落、新皮膚形成
strings.en: Avoid sexual contact and close skin-to-skin contact until all lesions have crusted, scabs have fallen off, and new skin has formed

strings.zh: 痂皮脫落且皮膚已癒合後不需再換藥
strings.en: Once scabs fall off and skin has healed, no further dressing changes are needed

strings.zh: 發燒重新升高（超過初期病毒性發燒）
strings.en: Fever rising again (above the initial viral fever)

strings.zh: 充分飲水，維持均衡飲食
strings.en: Drink enough fluids and maintain a balanced diet

strings.zh: 適量蛋白質（肉、魚、蛋、豆製品）助癒合
strings.en: Adequate protein (meat, fish, eggs, soy products) supports healing
Avoid staying up late; get sufficient sleep

strings.zh: 戒菸戒酒（影響傷口癒合）
strings.en: Stop smoking and alcohol (both impair wound healing)

strings.zh: 堅硬或呈橡膠狀，界限清楚，位於深部
經常形成肚臍狀（似病灶頂部凹陷的一個點）
strings.en: often umbilicated (with a central depression at the top)

strings.zh: 不一定分布於身體許多部位
strings.en: may not be widely distributed across the body

strings.zh: 導致疤痕增生和疤痕色素沉著
strings.en: leads to hypertrophic scarring and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

strings.zh: 冷敷（冰敷)或清涼止癢藥膏
strings.en: Cold compress (ice pack) or cooling anti-itch ointment

strings.zh: 溫和的無香料清潔劑 + 溫水
避免熱水或刺激性肥皂
strings.en: Avoid hot water and irritating soaps

strings.zh: 生殖器或肛門附近皮疹可用坐浴
strings.en: Genital or perianal lesions can be soothed with sitz baths
Disinfect with bleach or disinfectant solution

strings.zh: 原則上不需常規塗抹抗生素藥膏
strings.en: Routine topical antibiotic ointment is generally not needed

strings.zh: 凡士林或優碘藥膏後覆蓋紗布
strings.en: Cover with petrolatum or povidone-iodine ointment, then gauze
Reduce friction-related skin breakdown from clothing

strings.zh: 細菌感染警訊（出現下列其中一項應就醫）
strings.en: Bacterial infection warning signs (any one warrants medical attention)

strings.zh: 急性期到痂皮脫落前（約一個月內）
strings.en: From acute phase until scabs fall off (within ~1 month)

strings.zh: 良好傷口照護 + 避免抓破 + 預防續發細菌感染
strings.en: Good wound care + avoid scratching + prevent secondary bacterial infection
Do NOT use during the acute phase

strings.zh: 矽膠凝膠、矽膠貼片、凡士林、無香精油質乳液
strings.en: Silicone gel, silicone sheets, petrolatum, fragrance-free emollient

strings.zh: 猴痘感染沒有特別禁忌的食物
strings.en: There are no specific food restrictions for mpox infection

strings.zh: 痊癒且傷口完全癒合前，不應施打雷射或醫美治療
strings.en: Do not undergo laser or cosmetic procedures until full recovery and wound healing

strings.zh: 會自行痊癒的病毒感染
不抓 + 溫和清潔 + 凡士林保護傷口
strings.en: Don't scratch + gentle cleansing + protect wounds with petrolatum

strings.zh: 充滿不透明液體並隆起，圓形，觸感堅硬，中心常形成凹陷（臍部）
strings.en: Raised and filled with opaque fluid; round, firm to the touch, often with a central umbilication

strings.zh: 痂皮形成 → 脫落 → 癒合，可能留下疤痕
strings.en: Crusts form → fall off → heal; scarring is possible
